sources.citation: Pick, Andrew. 2020. A reconstruction of Proto-Northern Adelbert phonology and lexicon. PhD dissertation, University of Hawai'i at Manoa.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 1.5.1 'Stress' (pp. 31-32): stress described only for Mauwake, Pamosu, Usan; 'the available data on stress in most languages are minimal or nonexistent'. Sec. 3.7 (p. 133): 'For Bepour and Moere, Z'graggen's work is the only published data available.' Sec. 3.9 Bepour (pp. 137-138): consonant inventory only (/p t ʔ m n f s h r w y/, no velars), based on Z'graggen's wordlist and tapes; nothing on stress. Sec. 9.3.3 (pp. 388-390): sound changes, nothing on stress.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Sec. 1.3 (p. 6): 'The marking of stress has been omitted, since the stress patterning has not been well established yet.' Sec. 2.22.22.12 (p. 50): Bepour 'Previously unrecorded'. Sec. 2.22.22.3 (p. 51) Ubean Family typology: Bepour has /ʔ/ not /k/, has /h/, lacks velar nasal; possessive/negation notes -- segmental and morphological only. Sec. 2.22.8 (p. 73): 'None of the languages appears to be tonal' (Adelbert Range Phylum). Nothing on stress placement.
